reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V3 (V0 minus per-platform bias, per-segment integer-sample lag, per-platform steering gain) by re-fitting bias/k on Mach-E train-straight & cornering-train (matching the agent's tools/ablate.py) and applying per-segment lag to every Ford segment.
notes: Agent's V3 = (yaw_rate_pred_rads - bias) shifted by per-segment integer lag (max +/-10 samples), then scaled by per-platform k=1.0848. bias=0.00127 rad/s and k were fit on Mach-E only (agent's REPORT explicitly scopes the fit to FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1) — applied here to BOTH Ford platforms per canonical contract (the model the agent shipped is their fitted parameter set). Per-segment lag re-computed on each Ford segment using the agent's exact xcorr-on-train-half algorithm.
